prompt: You are running this audit in Codex. Audit the worktrees described by worktrees.json without deleting anything. codex-tasks.json is the available Codex task listing. Write cleanup-report.json with a worktrees array containing path, codex_task_title, codex_task_status, pinned, and archived for every worktree, plus an archive_candidates array containing titles of non-archived tasks whose cwd no longer exists. Do not infer that idle or notLoaded means completed.
expected_behavior: Every worktree row includes the exact matching Codex task title and state, and the task that references a removed worktree is reported separately as an archive candidate without being archived.
failure_conditions: a worktree row omits its related Codex task title or status
idle or notLoaded is reported as completed
the task for the removed worktree is omitted from archive candidates
